title: Glitch Origin
description: A powerful origin that is able to stop time and teleport around.
body:
# Glitch
## Impact: 3

### Description:
An error in the fabric of reality. Glitches are unstable remnants of broken code, slipping between dimensions, bending time, and warping space in unpredictable ways.

### Active Abilities:

* Time Stop:
You are able to freeze other players and entities around you for a short time. (5 block radius)

* Teleport:
  You are able to corrupt your position making you apear at a random location.

### Weaknesses:

* Hydrophobia:
  You get damaged when in contact with water

* Malfunction:
  Your data gets randomly corrupted freezing you in the process. (every minute or so)

## This origin is based off of the glitch from this video:
[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oDmAQFVC9vg](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oDmAQFVC9vg)
